summary: 8.5, up from w18 (8.3) and level with w17. No high or medium issue is left. The w18 black slot is fixed. On the q14 foreground seat the bead is now 1-2 px at L 32-58 against neighbouring shell and fabric at L 86-100 (w18: 7-9 px at L 4-23). Its path is continuous and smooth: a dark pixel is found in 423 of 425 rows, with a maximum deviation of 1.8 px from a cubic fit, so the 32 steps show no chord kinks. At mid range (q14 left pair, q13, p7, p8) it is a 1 px crease at L 38-64, or barely visible. That matches the photo: py_37303 shows a 1-2 px dip to L 60-80 against shell L 100 at the same junction (rows 180-200, x 745-760). In the lower third of the near seat the render is still a little darker than the photo (L 32-42), but it no longer reads as a cord. The w18 cubby-mouth darkening is unchanged against w18 (p5: 10 px differ). The nose-step removal is neutral (p8 and p5 change by no more than 2 px at the nose). Against w17 the bead adds a small, correct outline dark, but the metric barely moves (q14 3.78 -> 3.86 %, photo 6.13 %), and the w15 / w17 fabric, pocket and specular lows are untouched. So the score stays at 8.5, not above it.
lighting_note: Not scored. The bead still depends on crevice AO: one #3e434d base renders at L 32-42 low on the near q14 seat and at L 50-64 higher up and at mid range. Any change to AO strength will move this detail again.
